limitations: Independent agent walkthrough in headless Chromium by a different agent from the author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The lab openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2 (work2) is shared with other DOC-030 walkthrough agents. The runs created only records named "DOC-030 entities ...". API calls prepared fixtures, made the other actor's competing write, or read back results the browser had already shown; every documented action ran through the browser controls.

Run 1 (tag 0925-1129) walked guide sha256 d81e8cf1… and failed four steps: the guide named the entry row controls Edit entry 003 and Remove entry 003, while the rows read Edit entry 2 and Remove entry 5. The author corrected the guide to 0a4b028b…. Run 2 walked V-C53 again in full for both roles, because the edit and delete steps need the register that the earlier steps build. This record uses run 2; walkthrough.json keeps both runs with their times.

7 page loads in run 2 showed the app's "Something went wrong." screen with net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED while other labs changed the host's Docker networks; the script reloaded once and the step then passed. This is an environment effect, not an app finding.
The legacy par-value fixture (125 minor units with no currency) was set with a SQL update on the walkthrough's own Entity, because the API now refuses a par value without a currency.
Linked Matters: no Matter type in this lab has an Entity-valued Field, so the Matters tab showed "No linked records."; the roll-up through Entity-valued Fields was not exercised.
Not exercised: the Conversion entry kind and the ownership-loop refusal for register entries. Allotment, Transfer, Buyback and Cancellation from treasury were walked.

Product bugs recorded in the log: a hand-typed owner is still accepted on an Entity with a register (the guide describes it); the reconciliation line reports agreement when Issued shares is blank (the guide warns about it); entry rows use two icon buttons instead of the shared row menu; History prints "someone" and "someone%" for Holdings written by the register.

Author limitation, checked on the lab: The Record entry dialog has many kind-dependent controls; the guide describes the Holder rules per kind and the certificate controls in summary. The walkthrough needs at least one Share class and an Allotment to exercise V-C53's capital facts on the register.
Author limitation, checked on the lab: When Issued shares is blank the reconciliation line reports agreement (see productBugs); the guide tells readers to enter the declared value first.
